name: a_theoretical_max
description: Ceiling of the written rules + scoresheet under the DEFAULT ruling (zone 5 counts, base additive, platform is not board). Every piece scores: 5 ducks one-per-zone for 5x; 4 rainbow/unique pom groups of 5 + one rainbow group of 4 (optimal split of the 24 non-mystery poms, checked by exhaustive DP in test_score.py); Mystery Red Pom alone on the platform; Botguy on platform; Big Duck swapped into Botguy's start; 4 pickleballs under the platform; all 6 rings on necks; cups nested AND both flat (60, as the scoresheet allows). Not physically attainable in 120 s; the nested+both-flat cup state is probably physically impossible (see rules-digest.md ambiguity A5).
